# Ven0m0 .github

> Organization-wide defaults for all Ven0m0 repositories: community health files, GitHub Copilot instructions, AI agents, reusable skill modules, scoped instruction standards, reusable CI/CD workflows, and prompt templates.

This repository serves as the Ven0m0 organization's central configuration hub. GitHub automatically inherits community health files (CODE_OF_CONDUCT, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY) from here when individual repositories do not define their own. Beyond GitHub defaults, it ships a full AI-assisted development toolkit: 14 specialized agents organized into a 5-phase pipeline (explorer → planner → researcher → coder → reviewer), 29 reusable skill modules covering architecture, code quality, frontend, CI/CD, and domain specializations, 37 scoped Copilot instruction files keyed to file types, and a collection of reusable GitHub Actions workflows callable from any repository in the organization.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Quick-start overview — what this repo provides and how to use it
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Complete reference for all 14 AI agents, pipeline workflow, skills, instructions, reusable workflows, and development conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines and pull request process
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Security policy and vulnerability reporting
- [Copilot Instructions](copilot-instructions.md): Organization-wide GitHub Copilot behavioral instructions
- [Copilot Context Mode](copilot-context-mode-instructions.md): Context-mode configuration for Copilot

- [Instructions Index](instructions/INDEX.md): Navigation guide listing all 37 instruction modules with scopes and file-type mappings
- [Meta-Authoring](instructions/meta-authoring.instructions.md): Standards for writing agents, skills, instructions, and prompts
- [CI/CD Standards](instructions/cicd-standards.instructions.md): GitHub Actions patterns, workflow conventions, action pinning
- [Quality Standards](instructions/quality-standards.instructions.md): Code review rubric, performance gates, coverage thresholds
- [JavaScript/TypeScript](instructions/javascript.instructions.md): JS/TS coding standards (strict mode, typing, imports, React)
- [Python](instructions/python.instructions.md): Python standards (PEP 8/484, type hints, tooling with uv/ruff/mypy)
- [Bash](instructions/bash.instructions.md): Shell scripting standards (safety flags, shellcheck, shfmt)
- [Rust](instructions/rust.instructions.md): Rust idiomatic patterns and tooling
- [Go](instructions/go.instructions.md): Go 1.23+ standards
- [Docker](instructions/docker.instructions.md): Dockerfile and containerization best practices
- [Markdown](instructions/markdown.instructions.md): Documentation writing standards
- [AI Tuning](instructions/ai-tuning.instructions.md): AI assistant configuration and output compression
- [Token Efficiency](instructions/token-efficient.instructions.md): Context optimization strategies

## Agents

- [Orchestrator](agents/orchestrator.agent.md): Drives the 5-phase development pipeline in auto or gated mode
- [Explorer](agents/explorer.agent.md): Fast codebase scanning, structure mapping, and pattern identification
- [Planner](agents/planner.agent.md): Architecture design, requirements analysis, and task breakdown
- [Researcher](agents/researcher.agent.md): Library investigation, best practices, and external documentation
- [Coder](agents/coder.agent.md): TDD-driven implementation following plan and research artifacts
- [Reviewer](agents/reviewer.agent.md): Critical analysis returning pass/fail/conditional verdicts
- [Workflow Engineer](agents/workflow-engineer.agent.md): GitHub Actions specialist for CI/CD workflows
- [Git Expert](agents/git.agent.md): Version control workflows and GitHub CLI operations
- [Frontend Specialist](agents/frontend-specialist.agent.md): React/Next.js component and UI architecture
- [Debug](agents/debug.agent.md): Bug diagnosis and fix specialist
- [Codebase Maintainer](agents/codebase-maintainer.agent.md): Cleanup, tech debt removal, and repo indexing
- [Doc Writer](agents/doc-writer.agent.md): Technical documentation generation (invoke explicitly)
- [GH AW Builder](agents/gh-aw-builder.agent.md): GitHub Agentic Workflow creation and configuration
- [Arch Linux Expert](agents/arch-linux-expert.agent.md): Arch Linux administration and pacman workflows

## Workflows

- [Comprehensive Lint](.github/workflows/comprehensive-lint.yml): Multi-language linting via MegaLinter — callable from any repo
- [Reusable CI TypeScript](.github/workflows/reusable-ci-typescript.yml): TypeScript/Node CI with pnpm, vitest, coverage
- [Reusable CI Python](.github/workflows/reusable-ci-python.yml): Python CI with uv, pytest, and coverage thresholds
- [Reusable CI Bun](.github/workflows/reusable-ci-bun.yml): Bun runtime CI pipeline
- [Security](.github/workflows/security.yml): SAST, CodeQL, and dependency review
- [Dependabot Automerge](.github/workflows/dependabot-automerge.yml): Auto-merge passing dependency update PRs
- [Git Maintenance](.github/workflows/git-maintenance.yml): Repository cleanup, stale branch removal
- [Reusable Release](.github/workflows/reusable-release.yml): Semantic versioning and release automation

- [Create README](prompts/create-readme.prompt.md): Prompt for generating repository README files
- [Create AGENTS.md](prompts/create-agentsmd.prompt.md): Prompt for generating AGENTS.md documentation

- [Best Practices](prompts/best-practices.prompt.md): Prompt for applying language best practices
- [Update Markdown Index](prompts/update-markdown-file-index.prompt.md): Prompt for keeping markdown file indexes current
